style: 3D animated, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, hard sun, high exposure
motion_rule: the ant moves his whole body sideways through the sand every beat; the camera tracks with him at his eye level, never stops; shot size shifts with his body, half the frame to filling it, never leaving frame; sand, grass and worker ants always behind him
character: the ant: glossy black ant, tired eyes, twitchy antennae; the fat bronze dung beetle boss; worker ants; ONE mosquito
props: ONE gold coin stack; ONE banknote ball; ONE bread loaf; ONE crumb; furry mic bottom right
environment: sunlit sandy anthill yard, grass blades, pebbles; a line of worker ants hauling coins across the yard; the beetle boss with a banknote ball by a bread loaf

audio.delivery: high squeaky male voice, weary but brisk, 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: ya ta-SHU na se-BYE BOL'-she, chem VYE-shu SAM. a v i-TO-ge hva-TA-yet TOL'-ko na od-NU KROSH-ku
audio.pacing: 0.6-6.2 one continuous flow, no pause inside; after 6.2 not a word, sfx go on
audio.sfx: coin clinks, sand scrapes, swooshes, buzz, crunch

timeline.a: two worker ants tip ONE gold coin stack off a pebble onto the ant's back; he buckles and skids sideways across the sand, stack swaying
the ant carries the stack sideways left to right on six scrabbling legs, stack swaying, jaws open on every word
the ant hauls the stack back right to left in a zigzag scuttle, legs buckling, nose ploughing the sand, jaws open on every word; ONE worker ant drops one more coin on top
the beetle boss rolls his banknote ball in and scoops the whole stack off the ant's back; the ant is shoved sideways and slides across the sand facing the lens, jaws open on every word
the ant scuttles sideways after the rolling ball, belly low, all six legs scrabbling, antennae whipping, jaws open on every word; the beetle boss rolls the banknote ball ahead across the sand
the beetle boss snaps ONE crumb off the bread loaf and flicks it; the crumb smacks the ant in the face, knocking him backwards through the sand
the ant slides on his belly hugging the crumb, gives the lens a flat look, antennae drooping; worker ants haul coins behind him
ONE mosquito dives in from the lens edge, bites the crumb and drags it sideways; the ant clings on and is dragged across the sand on his belly
the crumb snaps in half; the ant is flung back, rolling over with the half crumb, sand bursting at the lens
the ant lands sliding on his belly and gulps the half crumb whole, cheeks bulging
ONE gold coin flicked by the beetle boss clinks onto the ant's back; he buckles and skids sideways, sand flying across the lens

must_appear: hook 0.0: stack onto his back; beetle scoops it 3.2; crumb in his face 6.2; mosquito drags crumb 7.4; coin onto his back 9.3
negative_prompt: held mic, a second mosquito, slow motion, any word after 6.2, silent tail, accented Russian, letters, numbers, price tags, subtitles, logo, watermark, English speech, pause inside a line, extra word, mouth shut, duplicate props, floating objects, a hero running at the camera on his feet, a wide shot, a distant hero, a parked camera, static scenery, a motionless first or last second, top-down view, a cart, a rail, sky, sun in frame, low angle, standing on hind legs, on the spot
